campaign: MOSS in overgo does what the MOSS Ultra workflow does in ComfyUI, each section held to ComfyUI's recording

items.title: overgo runs every section of the MOSS Ultra workflow: bong_tangent, beta57 and request sigmas, ER-SDE, image to image, depth estimation and control, prompt modes 2 and 3, and the finishing steps

steps.title: Depth control concatenates the VAE-encoded, normalised map times strength to the noise channels for the first half of sigma, through the control adapter's widened input layer
steps.rationale:
The map comes from overgo's depth estimator or from an image the request supplies; it is encoded with the VAE, given the Flux2 latent normalisation, resized bilinearly to the latent size, and concatenated as [zeros | depth] x strength to the noise channels for the first 50% of sigma.

Serves: a capability MOSS lacks.
Disappears: nothing.
Evidence: the depth section meets its golden floor.
Batch: device lane.

steps.title: Prompt mode 2's enhancer and mode 3's boxes run as typed Go, the cleaned negative and the layout string equal to ComfyUI's
steps.rationale:
The recorder reads the enhancer's system prompts and request templates out of the workflow file as data. Sampling follows the workflow: temperature 0.7, top-k 20, top-p 0.8, presence penalty 1.5, seed 0, thinking off. The 450-word test with one retry, the negative written from the final positive, the photo-or-other choice and the negative clean-up are Go string code, not regular expressions. Mode 3 converts 0 to 1000 boxes to centred-pixel yxyx layout JSON, which overgo already validates.

Note: 2026-11-17, from moss-ultra-import/encoder: the enhancer's chat runs the Ultra encoder file with its head (lm_head, int8 ConvRot like the rest) through overgo's LLM serving, the file's own names those of a Hugging Face checkpoint for generation (model.language_model., lm_head), which overgo's Qwen 3.5 adapter maps. ComfyUI's generate runs the int8 matmul with activations quantized per row after the rotation (comfy_kitchen int8_linear), where its conditioning decodes the weights; greedy text is held token for token, so the chat's own path is the one to match.

Serves: capabilities MOSS lacks.
Disappears: nothing.
Evidence: given the same generated text, the cleaned negative equals ComfyUI's string exactly; the generated text is held token for token under greedy decoding; sampled text is compared only through the image; mode 3's layout equals the recorded string.
Batch: device lane.

Serves: held-out-quality (agreement), first-output and peak-device-memory against ComfyUI on the same files.
Disappears: nothing.

steps.title: MOSS-Image-SFT with the official encoder runs every section, DMD2 and the control adapter applied to it, its agreement with the golden recorded as a band
steps.rationale:
The owner's plan of 2026-11-05 keeps the golden on the workflow's models and adds a separate check that the model overgo already serves works in the workflow. Mode 2's enhancer runs on a served Qwen3.5-9B. The weights differ, and the 50-step golden is Base without SFT, so agreement is reported as a band, not held to the golden's floor.

items.title: MOSS-Image-SFT gains the workflow's eight-step Turbo preset, the local DMD2 adapter unmerged at guidance 1, held to the workflow's Turbo recordings

steps.title: MOSS-Image-SFT gains the workflow's eight-step Turbo preset, the local DMD2 adapter unmerged at guidance 1, held to the workflow's Turbo recordings
steps.rationale:
Filed again from media-lora/moss-eight-step, the owner's order of 2026-11-17: the last of the MOSS Ultra workflow's rows, after moss-ultra-compare, and its check the workflow's Turbo recordings (fixtures/comfy/moss-ultra/recordings: text-to-image-turbo, image-to-image-turbo, depth-control-turbo), not the 415-question suite: no suite readings on the workflow's path.

MOSS's 50-step denoise takes 63.4 s at 1024 x 1024 (docs/MOSS_IMAGE.md). The Kromoss 8-steps-dmd2-lora (rank 128, F32, Apache-2.0) is on disk in the ComfyUI install and imported by moss-ultra-import. It was trained on Base, not SFT, so SFT's agreement with the recordings is a band, as moss-ultra-compare/sft-band reports.

Serves: first-output.
Disappears: nothing; the 50-step recipe stays.
Evidence: the preset runs eight steps at guidance 1 with the adapter unmerged, its time recorded and its pictures held to the Turbo recordings.
Batch: device lane.

items.title: When the slow test stage fails, the landing records the failing test by name

steps.title: When the slow test stage fails, the landing's refusal and its record name each failing test and its package
steps.rationale:
The owner's note of 2026-11-17 keeps the small fixes that protect working models: the slow tests are rerun, and the failing test is recorded when the slow test stage fails. On 2026-11-17 a landing was refused by its lanes with a cause that named no test, and the lanes passed when run again, so the failing test was never known.

Disappears: a lanes refusal that names no test.
Evidence: a failing lane's refusal and record name the failing tests.

items.title: SenseNova's request-resources test is measured again on a card to itself and carries modeltest, so the gate's cuda lane runs no real-model test

steps.title: SenseNova's request-resources test is measured again on a card to itself and carries modeltest, so the gate's cuda lane runs no real-model test
steps.rationale:
The evidence: cuda-synthetic/tag moved every untagged CUDA test that reads the data root behind modeltest but one. TestSenseNovaVariableRequestResources runs SenseNova's 8B production generation in an isolated measurement process, and docs/image_video_capacity.json names its retained measurement by the bytes of its file (evidence:sha256:888854b5...), which the store holds; tagged, its bytes changed and TestImageVideoCapacityAcceptance found no evidence under the new identity. A measurement is taken again only on a card to itself, and the readings campaign holds the card until its Wan arms are drawn, so the file stays in the gate, named by the check as measuredInPlace, and this row follows the campaign.

The change: the test carries //go:build modeltest, it is measured again on a quiet card into the store, the capacity record and its protocol digest (imageVideoCapacitySHA256) name the new identity, and measuredInPlace goes, so internal/sensenovarecipe leaves the cuda lane.

Check: a whole-tree test with measuredInPlace gone, named afresh so it fails before the change: TestTheGateRunsNoRealModelTest.

Refiled 2026-11-16 from cuda-resources/do, whose step carried no card need, so dispatch gave it while the readings campaign held the card: this step carries -needs-card and waits for a card to itself.

decisions.question: skill.md's 227 rule lines each cite a check. Read at 3ba4de8c7: the first check of 181 has a doc comment and of 45 has none, and the comments state what their test holds, not the rule that cites it ("purpose = recursive self-improvement ..." cites TestCycleFilesDeclinesAndAcceptsNothing, whose comment is the cycle's comparisons; "scorecard columns = ..." cites TestScorecardRowsEveryServableModel, whose comment is rows and dashes). Writing skill.md from the comments as they stand changes what it says. Which form does skill.md take?
options: Each rule line moves onto its first check as a doc-comment line of its own, and skill.md is generated from those lines and its judgement section, so it says what it says now, each rule written once on its check
skill.md holds its terms and judgement lines alone; the rule lines go, each check saying its rule when it refuses
skill.md is written from the tests' doc comments as they stand, its wording changing to theirs
decisions.recommendation: Each rule line moves onto its first check as a doc-comment line of its own, and skill.md is generated from those lines and its judgement section, so it says what it says now, each rule written once on its check
